meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 遇到容器代理故障时,Claude 会按指南排查:查看日志、查询会话数据库、检查挂载配置,并定位常见问题(如重复实例、认证失败、容器未启动)的根因,给出修复步骤。
howto.when: 当容器运行异常、失败或出现认证问题等,或想弄懂其工作原理时。

say.text: 容器启动就退出,帮我查下原因。
say.note: Claude 会查日志和会话DB,定位退出码。

say.text: 看看 inbound 和 outbound 数据库里有没有消息记录。
say.note: 判断消息是否到达容器、是否生成回复。

say.text: 为什么消息已投递但没送达?查一下适配器。
say.note: 对应常见问题1:重复实例导致消息丢失。

howto.what_en: On container agent issues, Claude inspects logs, queries session DBs, checks mount configurations, identifies root causes of common problems (duplicate instances, auth failures, container not replying), and suggests fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when containers misbehave, fail, or show auth errors, or when you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The container exits right after start; find out why.
say_en.note: Claude checks logs and session DBs for the exit code.

say_en.text: Check the inbound and outbound DBs for message records.
say_en.note: Shows whether messages arrived and replies were generated.

say_en.text: Messages show delivered but were never sent; check the adapter.
